subject: Data eradication handshake — scope, timestamps, and delivery of evidence
messages:
From: Helen Park <h.park@medplustech.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: MedPlus Tech Security <security@medplustech.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: full eradication (prompts/outputs/logs) and confirmation timeline

Hi Marissa,

Per our compliance review we need Redwood to perform a full eradication of all generated assistant prompts, assistant outputs, and related inference logs tied to our account (customer id: MP-9938) for the date range 2023-06-01 to 2025-06-01.

Key asks:
- A one-week target window for execution (we can accept 6/23–6/27)
- A manifest of objects removed (filenames / log ranges)
- Cryptographically-signed confirmation that the sweep ran and the final manifest hash
- Any temporary service-impact windows or read-only periods

Can you confirm Redwood's workflow and whether we need to provide any additional approval or PoA? Please include the names of the internal contacts who will execute and who will sign the certificate.

Thanks,
Helen Park
Head of Privacy & Compliance
MedPlus Tech
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Helen Park <h.park@medplustech.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 17:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: full eradication (prompts/outputs/logs) and confirmation timeline

Hi Helen — thanks for the clear ask. We can accommodate your window and provide a signed eradication certificate. High-level plan below; technical runbook attached.

Planned cadence:
1) Prep & approval (you): confirm POA & final date by 6/20
2) Dry run on a replica namespace (no data change): 6/21–6/22
3) Production sweep (non-reversible): 6/23 starting 02:00 UTC — estimated 6–10 hours depending on shard load
4) Post-sweep verification & signed certificate delivery: within 24 hours after finalization

What we will remove: prompt inputs, derived assistant outputs, KV cache derivatives and inference logs (token-level logs, request/response traces) that reference MP-9938. We will not touch your persisted object store outside Redwood-managed inference artifacts unless specifically requested.

Impacts: brief read-only on inference logs during the sweep (we'll coordinate a maintenance window); hosted API routing will remain available via cached variants.

Next steps: please reply with explicit approval and the single-signer name (title/email) you authorize. Once we have that, Rishi will post the runbook and coordinate the execution timeline.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: eradication_runbook_v1.pdf
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Helen Park <h.park@medplustech.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 09:08:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: full eradication (prompts/outputs/logs) and confirmation timeline

Helen / Marissa — adding the ops/security playbook details. Summary of technical steps (from runbook):

- Identify objects: query index for MP-9938 namespace (artifact IDs, KV tombstone keys, logchain segments)
- Snapshot metadata manifest and compute SHA-256 manifest hash (signed with KMS key: redwood-erad-2025)
- Execute coordinated sweep per-shard: mark tombstones, zeroize KV segments, and delete request/response traces from hot and cold stores
- Run verification jobs that re-query indexes to confirm zero results and compare produced manifest hash to pre-sweep snapshot
- Generate eradication_certificate_YYYYMMDD.json with signed manifest hash and list of removed object IDs

Estimated runtime: 6–12 hours depending on concurrency; we will throttle to preserve your SLOs. During the sweep there will be a short read-only period for the inference-log index (expected < 30 minutes per region).

Attachments: sweep_manifest_20250619.csv (preview of manifest format)

Operational contacts for execution and signing:
- Rishi Malhotra — Security & Infra Lead (will trigger sweep)
- Marissa Cole — Customer Success (customer liaison and certificate signer)
- Laura Bennett — Legal (review of certificate language)

Please confirm authorization and whether we can proceed with the dry run on 6/21. If authorized, we'll publish an exact UTC start time for the production sweep and a link to the live audit job.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Security & Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Helen Park <h.park@medplustech.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 22:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: full eradication (prompts/outputs/logs) and confirmation timeline

Helen — thanks for the authorization earlier today (email thread attached). This is to confirm completion of the production sweep for MP-9938 performed on 2025-06-19 starting 02:15 UTC.

Execution summary:
- Sweep started: 2025-06-19T02:15:24Z (UTC)
- Sweep completed: 2025-06-19T08:42:09Z (UTC)
- Objects removed: 14,832 artifacts (prompt inputs/assistant outputs), 3,412 logchain segments, 9,120 KV tombstones
- Manifest SHA-256: a3f4b7c2d9e8f6b1a0c5e2e6f9a4b0c3d2e1f7a9b0c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a

Deliverables attached: eradication_certificate_20250619.json (signed by Marissa Cole, Redwood KMS key redwood-erad-2025) and sweep_manifest_20250619.csv (object-level details redacted to hash prefixes for privacy). Evidence record has been uploaded to your shared audit folder at: https://drive.redwood.com/s/eradication_runbook_v1.pdf and to our internal audit: https://redwood-infra.internal/audit/ERAD-2025-06-19-84

No further action is required unless you'd like a full (non-redacted) object list under NDA. Please reply to confirm receipt and acceptance; we will close the ticket and mark the account sweep as complete in our system.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: eradication_certificate_20250619.json
